name: AICOSO Pickup and Delivery Date Time for WooCommerce
author: aicoso

sections.description:
Woocommerce local pickup plugin lets customers choose and schedule pickup or delivery based on their convenience, making it a flexible woocommerce delivery plugin for woocommerce based local stores.

WooCommerce Local Pickup Plugin for Pickup & Delivery Scheduling

Woocommerce local pickup plugin is a purpose built and developed extension to provide store owners the control over customer orders by offering local pick up and home delivery.
With local pickup fields in checkout for woocommerce plugin, customers can choose their desired delivery and pickup date and time even on the check out page.
It enhances customer satisfaction by offering clear options and choices for delivery and pickup timing while giving store owners full control over the backend interface.

From in-Store Pickup, up to Date Schedules You can not go wrong with this woocommerce delivery plugin.
Whether you are running a local store, restaurant or grocery store, the plugin makes your workflow easier and smooth with the help of date based scheduling, pickup location, delivery management. All in one simple but powerful system.

Local Pickup WooCommerce Plugin for Store Pickup Management Check Out Local Pickup!

Local pickup woocommerce plugin Local Pickup for WooCommerce Save time and get more customers to pick up their orders locally!

  • With custom settings, merchants can easily make the pick up address availableat multiple locations and customers could choose the pick-up date and time from any specific location. This makes it perfect for those businesses who are using woocommerce local pickup.
  • Multiple Pickup Location support with woocommerce local pickup plus like style and functionality
  • Ability to troubleshoot this and other issues yourself – woocommerce local pickup not showing even after settings have been correctly set.
  • Choice to activate the hide shipping address for pickup only orders in woocommerce
  • Improved checkout experience for customers

As the pickup workflows are now simplified, the plugin functions just great as a store pickup for woocommerce and contributes to saving delivery costs while offering added convenience to the customer.

WooCommerce Delivery with Date & Time Slot

A flexible woocommerce delivery plugin, customers can schedule their deliveries by selecting appropriate delivery dates and time slots on the checkout page. As a shop manager, you can have full control over order delivery dates for woocommerce. The Liquid Store Pickup woocommerce allows for seamless delivery or picking up at a store, thus we will help you to prepare for optimal and perfect pickup as deliveries.

Highlights of the woocommerce local pickup plus plugin include:

  • Accurate estimated delivery date woocommerce display
  • Product-level delivery and pickup control for product delivery date for woocommerce
  • Delivery slot management using delivery woocommerce settings
  • Support for defining delivery zones using woocommerce delivery area

This makes the plugin a reliable delivery woocommerce plugin for stores that want full control over delivery timelines and logistics.

Delivery WooCommerce Plugin for Admin & Delivery Staff Control

Delivery woocommerce plugin offers manageable backend settings for setting up the pickup and delivery operations efficiently. Woocommerce store owners can set the blackout dates, different availability rules, and pickup locations to ensure a smooth process. It also integrates seamlessly with woocommerce orders workflows.

Key features includes:

  • Dedicated order management dashboard with delivery and pickup details
  • Woocommerce pickup locations and time mangement
  • Automated email notifications for pickup and delivery confirmations
    These features make it ideal for local businesses, restaurants, and grocery stores needing scalable delivery and pickup solutions.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the aicoso-pickup-and-delivery-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Pickup & Delivery to configure the plugin
  4. Set up your pickup locations and delivery zones
  5. Configure time slots and scheduling rules
  6. The pickup/delivery options will automatically appear on your checkout page
sections.faq:
Can customers choose both pickup and delivery options at checkout?

Yes, local pickup woocommerce plugin allows customers to select either woocommerce local pickup or delivery during checkout, along with their preferred date and time.

Does this plugin support estimated delivery dates?

Yes, with the help of this plugin estimated delivery date woocommerce helps customers understand delivery timelines clearly.

What if local pickup is not showing on checkout?

Site admin can navigate to the pickup and delivery setting to resolve the Issues like woocommerce local pickup not showing.

Can I limit the number of orders per time slot?

Yes, You can set a limit for a maximum number of orders per time slot. These smart options help you manage the pickup and delivery capacity.

Whether you require an authentic and reliable local pickup woocommerce plugin or an advanced and versatile woocommerce delivery plugin with scheduling options, this plugin covers everything from pickup to delivery, Locations to date and time management.
With easy and usable admin options, and customer-friendly checkout features, this plugin increases both operational efficiency and user experience.
